intro: Serbian is one of the few languages written equally in two alphabets, and family celebrations and hospitality are central to Serbian life.

chapters.title: People and language
text: Belgrade, Novi Sad and Niš are the largest cities. Serbian is written in both Cyrillic and Latin letters, and many signs use both. There is a large Hungarian minority in Vojvodina, along with Bosniaks, Roma and others. Most Serbs are Orthodox Christians.
Each family celebrates its slava, the feast day of its patron saint, a tradition on UNESCO's heritage list.

chapters.title: Daily life
text: Coffee with friends can last for hours, and Belgrade is famous for its nightlife, including clubs on river barges.

keyTerms.meaning: A Serbian family's yearly celebration of its patron saint.
